entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Samuel José Mejía is a Dominican-American professional basketball coach and former player. He is the current assistant for JL Bourg of the French LNB Élite. retired professional basketball player. He played college basketball at DePaul University. Standing at 6 ft 6 in (1.98 m), he played at the shooting guard and small forward positions.
